    Where harvest happened in one year, on the simulation's grid

    getCanLaDHarvest.Rd

    Reads one year's CanLaD annual disturbance raster (30 m; see the module's canladUrl), crops it to rasterToMatch with reproducible::prepInputs(), keeps the harvest classes, and projects the result onto rasterToMatch. A rasterToMatch pixel is cut when at least minFraction of the CanLaD pixels in it are harvest; sampling one 30 m pixel per simulation pixel instead would mark isolated pixels at random.

    getCanLaDHarvest(
  year,
  rasterToMatch,
  url,
  file,
  destinationPath,
  harvestClasses,
  minFraction
)

    Arguments

    year

    Integer. The year (1985 to 2025 for CanLaD v1.1).

    rasterToMatch

    SpatRaster. The grid and mask to return.

    url

    Folder holding the annual rasters (canladUrl), or NULL to use a file already in destinationPath.

    file

    File name (canladFile) of one year's raster, with %d where the year goes.

    destinationPath

    Where the raster is (or is downloaded to).

    harvestClasses

    Integer (harvestClasses). CanLaD classes that count as harvest.

    minFraction

    Numeric 0-1 (harvestMinFraction). See above.

    Value

    A SpatRaster on rasterToMatch: 1 cut, 0 not cut, NA where rasterToMatch is NA.
